crowded_consumer.snippet: Manually entering every grocery is frustrating, so our two-person household went back to a paper list and still throws food away.

crowded_consumer.title: Freezer tape works better than another app
crowded_consumer.snippet: The app was hard to use and required manual entry; we use paper labels because scanning every item takes too much time.

crowded_consumer.snippet: Reviewers say the subscription is too expensive for reminders and inventory sync is unreliable.
